paragraphs.text: Choose what deserves your attention, when progression or change summaries should reach you, and what can wait until you return.
Choose whether daily operating prompts, change summaries, and reminders should reach you.
Control reminders for weekly reflection, alignment, and carry-forward actions.
Receive updates when owned or relevant workflow activity needs attention.
Receive the changes and opportunities that materially affect active goals, owned work or required decisions. Let routine progression wait for a digest or your return.
Control whether jobs, training, events, grants, projects, experts and other supported opportunities may be matched to your goals and how often they reach you.
